text: 🇲🇽🌎 "Mexico does not specialize in the production of weapons, because it's a pacifist decision that was made a long time ago." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 Asked about last week's visit by South Korea's president, Sheinbaum said Asian countries have been hit hard by the Iran war as oil and gas importers facing higher prices and scarcity. For Korea the defense industry is central; "for us, Mexico has historically decided that the defense industry is not the best path to development." The two governments agreed on a K-pop culture center in Mexico and, in reciprocity, an institute of Mexican culture in Korea.

🇲🇽✊ "Our hypothesis, and we'll hold it until someone proves otherwise, of why they didn't build: why invest in what you intend to privatize?" — Zoé Robledo, IMSS Director General, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 IMSS enrollment has grown fast: 22.76 million formal workers (+13%), 5.9 million covered parents (+35% since 2018) and 6.3 million pensioners (+46%). "The demographics and the burden of chronic disease were no surprise 20 years ago," Robledo said, describing a drift toward subcontracted services and "a mixed public-private model that ends up 100% private."

🇲🇽⚖️ "Don't lie, don't steal, and don't betray the people." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 Sheinbaum's advice to the coordinators Morena just chose by poll to organize the Fourth Transformation's work, repeating the movement's founding principles. She said the process showed a lot of unity, and those who did not win can still compete for mayoral races and state and federal congressional seats.

🔥🇲🇽 "I have no idea why they called it the 'anti-meme law.' I don't know where they got that, because it's an absolute lie. There isn't a single article that has to do with that." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 The newly approved intellectual property law targets piracy and speeds up patents. It bars private parties from selling government symbols, such as the national coat of arms or a state's shield, for profit. Flags sold on September 15 are not affected. "It has nothing to do with someone putting a symbol on social media, or banning memes."

🇲🇽🌎 "I even personally sent a letter, not to the prime minister, but to the president of Israel, asking for his help." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 Tomás Zerón, former head of Mexico's Criminal Investigation Agency, is wanted in the Ayotzinapa case and has been in Israel since 2019. Mexico has no extradition treaty with Israel. The Attorney General's Office has sent more than 6,000 pages translated into English and Hebrew; President Isaac Herzog replied that his executive does not intervene in judicial decisions. The Office has also reassigned staff to speed up extraditions from the US and Israel.

🇲🇽🏭 "In no case is our sovereignty or our vision of development compromised." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 Asked about Marcelo Ebrard's talks with US officials on the USMCA review, as Washington threatens new tariffs on Canada, Sheinbaum said the teams meet again this week and no major deal has closed yet. "Our objective, obviously, is to lower the tariffs on steel and vehicles, and that there be no more tariffs."

🇲🇽📈 <u>Wall Street money manager drops South Africa and picks Mexico</u>

Morningstar, the US firm with $375 billion in assets, has cut South African stocks from its global portfolios. It named Brazil and Mexico as its top emerging-market bets outside Asia. For Mexico, it likes basic-industry names and large caps like Coca-Cola Femsa.
